# hslToRgb

## Summary

Converts HSL (hue in degrees — any value, normalized internally; saturation and lightness in `[0, 1]`) to an `[r, g, b]` triple with each channel in `[0, 1]`.

## Import

```javascript
import { hslToRgb } from '../utils/munsell';
```

## Usage

```javascript
let [r, g, b] = hslToRgb(212, 0.8, 0.5);
```
